description: Hi everyone, I’m Roma! I’m interested in engineering, technology, and space! I’ll be working solo, but since I’m required to write a about myself and my team, here goes. You can be in our team evenif you beginner if we don’t end up winning, we’ll definitely create a fantastic project and make plenty of great memories! It’s just fun to work as part of a team. All I’m looking for in teammates is responsiveness, kindness, and a genuine passion for the process—that’s more than enough for me. Thanks!
